conclusion: A separate general physical_mass role is semantically justified for explicitly declared actual carrier mass/heaviness/lightness. It does not convert measured verification, appearance or support forces into physical mass.

after.description: Explicit physical mass or ordinary physical heaviness/lightness declared for one identified carrier or an explicitly owned part, including a stated comparison or literal numeric mass/weight value. Keep physical quantity, owner scope and source claim status distinct from appearance and measured verification.
after.description_ko: 하나의 실제 선언된 대상 또는 그 대상이 실제로 소유한 부위의 명시적 물리 질량·무게·가벼움·무거움. 명시된 비교와 질량·무게 수치도 포함하되, 물리량 종류·소유 범위·원문의 주장 수준을 보존하며 외관이나 측정 확인으로 확대하지 않는다.
includes: An explicitly lightweight garment or material body, heavy ledger or heavy gate qualifies on its actual declared carrier even without a number, unit or visual weighing demonstration. Do not delete the qualitative meaning because measurement is unavailable.

A statement that one identified carrier or explicitly owned part is lighter/heavier than another preserves both independently grounded endpoints and its stated comparison basis. No absolute mass, size ratio or density follows.

A source-stated numeric mass/weight preserves the literal number, unit, referent, quantity kind and stated conditions. It is a declared value unless the source separately states a measurement claim; neither is independently verified by a visible scale or numeral alone. Do not convert mass to force or change units.
Keep a local part value on that exact part. It does not become the whole owner mass or another region mass, and a whole value does not distribute to parts without an explicit source rule.

A selected physical mass/heaviness/lightness remains E. A separately required existing declared mass/weight is P; an explicit preserve instruction is PR. Actual change in mass retains both carrier and stated change, without inventing material addition/removal, a cause, rate or endpoint. A role label or an existing-owner selection is never a waiver of the actual selected effect.

Intrinsic human/adult/domain guards, independent owner selection, permitted operation and actual locks remain mandatory. A literal declared body mass is not inferred from body form; this role neither creates a person nor authorizes a body-weight change.
excludes: Visual/compositional weight, metaphorical narrative weight, emotional heaviness, heavy rain intensity, hair weight-line geometry, or a density/size/style label alone without an actual physical mass/weight proposition.

Lightweight-looking, heavy-looking, airy appearance, dense-looking texture or an evoked heavy/light sensation alone. Preserve that exact appearance or sensory wording, but do not upgrade it to actual mass. Sensory_cue requires its own observable-proxy contract; it is not an automatic fallback tag.

Thickness, macroscopic volume, garment fit, body contour, packing density, material identity, optical finish, stiffness, flexibility or thermal state alone. None supplies mass by inference, and a broad material.* technical prefix does not expand surface_material prose.

Body-weight distribution, load-bearing support, a force, pressure, gravitational acceleration, buoyancy, inertia, drag or motion alone. Keep explicit support/contact/motion independently; do not derive a mass or strength from them.
An ungrounded comparison endpoint, an unspecified collective inventory, a new object or anatomical part introduced to carry the property, or transfer from local part to whole/body/neighbor.

Actual body weight, health, ability, age, identity or attractiveness inferred from anatomy, clothing size, posture, a material name, perspective, or visible handling effort. No new human, body-weight target or change is supplied by the slot.

A scale, display number, weighing verb or provenance label alone is not verified mass or a certified measurement. Visible text, a measuring operation and actual declared quantity each retain separate evidence/permission; no force-versus-mass conversion or fabricated number/unit.
Metadata tags, existing effects/old slot names, negative guards, optional children or source owner category labels cannot supply a positive mass value or mandatory whole-record role.

surface_material.description: Declared surface material and observable optical response; chemical identity and performance require separate context.
surface_material.description_ko: 지정 표면의 재질과 광학 반응: 직조 조직은 texture도 가능; 화학 정체·온도·내구성을 외관만으로 확정하지 않음
excludes: 직조 조직은 texture도 가능; 화학 정체·온도·내구성을 외관만으로 확정하지 않음
includes: Declared surface material and observable optical response; chemical identity and performance require separate context.

garment_detail.description: Construction, topology, trim or local form of an identified garment, whether worn, displayed, standalone or represented, distinct from anatomy and material identity.
garment_detail.description_ko: 착용·전시·단독·묘사된 의복 자체의 구조·연결·트림·국소 형태. 실제 의복 소유자를 확인하며 인체 구조·피부 표식·재질 정체와 구별한다.
excludes: Cloth material or an unowned edge alone is not a garment construction detail.
A garment detail does not establish a wearer, anatomy, exposure, fit, material identity or clothing ensemble.
Do not remove any intrinsic source-specific human, adult or domain restriction.
includes: An actual garment-owned seam, cuff, hem, sleeve, trim or construction relation; an independently declared human wearer is not compulsory.
If a wearer, layering relation, support or attachment is required by the source, preserve that specific condition rather than deriving it from the slot.
Separately supported material, texture, fit, layering or state can have their own roles without duplicating the garment.

garment_fit.description: Relation of a garment's volume and contour to its declared wearer, without inferring body shape from clothing.
garment_fit.description_ko: 의복 핏: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Relation of a garment's volume and contour to its declared wearer, without inferring body shape from clothing.

physical_motion.description: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.
physical_motion.description_ko: 물리 움직임 상태와 촬영된 움직임 표현: 정지·깜빡임·카메라 흔들림·영상 궤적이 섞임; owner와 image plane별 분리 여부 결정
excludes: 정지·깜빡임·카메라 흔들림·영상 궤적이 섞임; owner와 image plane별 분리 여부 결정
includes: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.

scale_relation.description: Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.
scale_relation.description_ko: 둘 이상의 명시된 대상 간 크기 관계: 절대 크기·원근 왜곡과 구별; 비교 기준과 깊이 관계를 보존
excludes: 절대 크기·원근 왜곡과 구별; 비교 기준과 깊이 관계를 보존
includes: Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.

sensory_cue.description: Observable proxy for a proposed touch, heat, smell or sound interpretation, without claiming the sensation was measured.
sensory_cue.description_ko: 촉각·온도·소리·냄새를 연상시키는 관찰 단서: 수증기·진동·접촉을 실제 감각 확인과 구별; 단서와 서사 해석 연결
excludes: 수증기·진동·접촉을 실제 감각 확인과 구별; 단서와 서사 해석 연결
includes: Observable proxy for a proposed touch, heat, smell or sound interpretation, without claiming the sensation was measured.

subject.description: The primary declared visible entity or entities that the photograph is about.
subject.description_ko: 장면의 주된 관찰 대상: 동반 대상은 별도 소유자; 이름만으로 인원·종을 추가하지 않음
excludes: 동반 대상은 별도 소유자; 이름만으로 인원·종을 추가하지 않음
includes: The primary declared visible entity or entities that the photograph is about.

body_form.description: Owned non-facial anatomical contour, regional volume or visible muscle and tendon form of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation. Independent of connection topology, relative proportions, pose, garment fit and non-anatomical artifact construction.
body_form.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 얼굴 이외 해부학적 윤곽·국소 부피·근육·힘줄 형태이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 기관 형태도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 연결 구조·상대 비율·자세·의복 부피·비해부학적 물건 구조와 구별하며 생존 상태·종·건강·능력·정체성을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Body/plant region names, biological class words or connection topology alone without an independently stated anatomical contour or regional form.
Relative proportions, pose, facial geometry, garment fit or non-anatomical object/garment construction alone.

Floral graphic paths, repeating vegetal ornament, branch-shaped hardware or fabric/paper/lace flower parts do not become biological anatomy from resemblance or petal/stem labels. An explicitly declared anatomical depiction may describe represented organs only; its physical carrier remains an artifact.
A represented or artificial anatomical form does not alter or add a living actor/plant, and does not establish that its carrier is alive or that any depicted species exists physically.
Body weight, health, strength, biological age, origin, species, growth capacity, material chemistry or fabrication inferred from form.
Source owner, positive form and actual application scope must be explicit; metadata, source effects, an optional member/profile or an actor/plant/representation role word alone is not a form fact.
includes: Restrained visible muscle planes on a declared human or other animal; a localized neck vein contour or gluteal-thigh surface fold.

Large distinct floral segments forming an open cup on the declared botanical bloom; broad bounded leaf form or layered flower-organ form on its own declared plant owner. Plant form is not a claim of physiological life, growth capacity or species identification.

Explicitly depicted biological anatomy, including represented botanical organ form, stays on its declared representation. The source must actually describe anatomical form, not merely a floral style, motif or generic craft part.

A biological flower and a fabric rosette may occur in the same record, but anatomical form is assessed only on the declared biological flower or explicit anatomical depiction; cloth-fold form remains on the garment/craft owner.

thermal_state.description: Explicit physical temperature state or temperature change of an identified carrier, separate from illumination color temperature, emotional warmth and a sensory proxy.
thermal_state.description_ko: 소유자가 명시된 대상의 직접 선언된 물리 온도 상태 또는 온도 변화. 빛의 색온도, 정서적 온기, 열감을 연상시키는 단서와 구별한다.
excludes: Lighting warm/cool or Kelvin color temperature, emotional warmth/coldness, and skin warm-color cues alone.
Steam, a red appearance, gloss or a sensory proxy alone does not establish actual temperature or a heating cause.
Naming temperature as a measurement variable without a declared state, value or change does not supply a thermal-state fact.
Do not add heaters, flames, particles, melting, burns, chemical identity, a numeric value or a heat-transfer mechanism from a thermal state alone.
Cooling alone does not establish a phase change. Explicit melting/solidification or a selected transformation stage requires its own source-supported fact.
includes: An explicitly warm cup, hot metal or cold surface; its actual carrier must be identified.
Explicit cooling or heating preserves the actual temperature-change meaning, without inventing its mechanism, rate, endpoint or elapsed sequence.
Preserve a stated number and unit literally when both exist in the source; do not infer measurement certification or convert units.

A selected thermal state is an effect; a separately required existing thermal state is a prerequisite; an explicit preservation instruction keeps that same state. Decide each mode from the whole source.

overlap_analysis.conclusion: Material identity/optical response do not include mass. Broad material. property prefix is technical acceptance, not positive semantics; splitting mass from leather/corduroy/optics is required.
Construction/topology/trim/local form belongs to garment. Lightweight is a physical mass adjective, not garment seam/topology, and gate/ledger are not garments.
Volume/contour versus actual wearer is not mass; loose/bulky thin trousers can still be declared lightweight without a body-weight fact.
Motion/rest is not mass. Static heavy gate remains heavy; partly lowered does not prove current motion or weight.
Comparative geometric size with depth basis is not heavier/lighter. Keep endpoints but do not infer one quantity from another.
Observable touch/heat/smell/sound proxies do not replace literal actual lightweight/heavy. Appearance-only -looking must not be upgraded; existing sensory role needs its independent fullspec.
Entity identity/presence is not its mass. No new object/person from the need to carry a mass property.
Explicitly excludes inferred body weight. An actual declared mass can use its exact body/part carrier only with independent permission; contour/volume alone cannot supply it.
Independent physical temperature dimension already demonstrates state versus measurement separation. No warmth, chemistry, density or heat is mass evidence.
Rigidity/flexibility/deformation response is not mass. No change requested to prior proposed fullspec/artifact.
Local thickness is not mass or density. Preserve original5033 thin fabric AND KO lightweight independently; no change to prior fullspec/artifact.

heavy leather-bound ledger with unreadable marks, judgement and debt magic prop

witnesses.carrier: actual whole ledger; leather-bound covers remain their own material scope
witnesses.mode_proposal: E if selecting this ordinary noun-description as requested ledger meaning; only independently frozen existing heavy ledger supports P; no actual owner/request graph or permission signed here
witnesses.reason: Heavy directly modifies the ledger, independent of leather binding, mark legibility and judgement/debt magic context. No numeric weight or measured claim follows.
negative_boundaries: Do not replace physical heaviness with prop_state readiness or leather material.
Unmarked/unreadable names remain unreadable; heavy does not assert guilt, actual judgement, magic truth, force or body strength.
Historical5B KO expansion is separate from operating/current KO 죄악의 장부; this audit changes neither and does not delete that original context.

witnesses.carrier: actual whole selected trousers; not wearer body or all cloth everywhere
witnesses.mode_proposal: E for selected lightweight trouser meaning; existing-only P requires independently selected actual trousers and matching declared lightweight property. No source application completed.
witnesses.reason: KO 경량 is independent positive meaning. EN thin crinkled fabric and gathered OR drawcord openings neither negate that mass adjective nor measure it. Lack of grams is not a deletion rationale.
negative_boundaries: Do not rename lightweight as thin, loose fit or crinkled texture. Thickness, texture and fit remain separately owned facts.
Preserve gathered OR drawcord alternatives and actual garment scope; no parachute activity, wearer body mass, low density or fiber chemistry.
Old5B says no actual lightweight measurement; that correctly limits verification, but cannot erase explicit qualitative lightweight.

positive.quote: one readable central axis divides paired scene masses whose contours, spacing, and visual weight correspond across the frame while the main anchor remains aligned to that axis

typed_value.value: paired visual weights correspond around central axis

witnesses.mode_proposal: E composition proposal only; no physical_mass role/fact
witnesses.reason: Scene masses and visual weight are explicitly image composition terms. No physical quantity proposition or actual weighed carrier is declared.
negative_boundaries: Do not turn visual prominence or bilateral balance into equal kilograms, density, equal object count or real reflection.
Keep central anchor alignment and paired contours/spacing; no body asymmetry correction.

positive.quote: a heavy gridded gate partly lowered within vertical side grooves inside a fortified entrance

witnesses.carrier: actual gridded gate; not the entrance volume, grooves, human operator or entire fortress

negative_boundaries: No steel/iron composition, actuator, force, present lowering movement, attacker or siege follows.
No gate mass on the whole fortified entrance; no actual measurement or number.

witnesses.reason: The explicit suffix -looking limits the claim to visual appearance. Dense structure here does not independently state volumetric density; actual fibers remain source-declared OR, not visually proven.
negative_boundaries: Do not remove lightweight-looking or turn it into unqualified lightweight/heavy or measured low mass.
Do not infer density, origin, value, quality, worn garment or beige palette.
Existing sensory_cue prose is touch/heat/smell/sound proxy; this audit does not automatically qualify a sensory role solely from -looking.
